```{r}
# Loading packages
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Import the nonlocalized TSV file

nonlocalized_data <- "20250522_233958_PolyA_TiO_Report_precursor_noloc.tsv"
nonlocalized_data <- read_tsv(nonlocalized_data)

# Importing the second TSV file
localized_data <- "20250522_233958_PolyA_TiO_Report_precursor_loc.tsv"
localized_data <- read_tsv(localized_data)

# View the first few rows of both datasets
head(nonlocalized_data)
head(localized_data)
```
combine protein name and site, charge
```{r}
# Step 1: Extract the two characters following the underscore in EG.PrecursorId
nonlocalized_data$PrecursorSuffix <- sub(".*_(..)$", "\\1", nonlocalized_data$EG.PrecursorId)

# Step 2: Combine PG.ProteinNames, EG.ProteinPTMLocations, and the two characters from EG.PrecursorId
nonlocalized_data$Combined_Protein_Info <- paste(nonlocalized_data$PG.ProteinNames, 
                                                 nonlocalized_data$EG.ProteinPTMLocations, 
                                                 nonlocalized_data$PrecursorSuffix, 
                                                 sep = "_")

# Step 3: Reorder columns to make Combined_Protein_Info the first column
nonlocalized_data <- nonlocalized_data %>%
  select(Combined_Protein_Info, everything())

# Step 4: View the new data frame with the combined column as the first column
head(nonlocalized_data)
```

filter nonlocalized data to only include localized phos
```{r}
# Filter rows where at least two "PTMLocalizationProbabilities" columns are not "Filtered"
filtered_localized_data <- localized_data %>%
  filter(rowSums(select(., contains("PTMLocalizationProbabilities")) != "Filtered", na.rm = TRUE) >= 1)

# View the filtered dataset
head(filtered_localized_data)

# Assuming both data frames have a common column to join on, e.g., "id"
filtered_nonlocalized_data <- nonlocalized_data %>%
  filter(EG.PrecursorId %in% filtered_localized_data$EG.PrecursorId)

# View the filtered data
head(filtered_nonlocalized_data)
```
Identify abundance columns
```{r}
# Identify columns that contain "TotalQuantity" in the column name for filtered_nonlocalized_data
total_quantity_columns_filtered <- grep("TotalQuantity", colnames(filtered_nonlocalized_data), value = TRUE)

# View the columns found in filtered_nonlocalized_data
total_quantity_columns_filtered
```
```{r}
# Loop over each "TotalQuantity" column in filtered_nonlocalized_data
for (col in total_quantity_columns_filtered) {
  # Get the column values
  column_values <- filtered_nonlocalized_data[[col]]
  
  # Filter out rows with 0 or "Filtered"
  valid_rows <- !(column_values %in% c('0', "Filtered"))
  
  # Count the number of valid rows (excluding 0 and "Filtered")
  valid_row_count <- sum(valid_rows)
  
  # Calculate the sum of valid rows (excluding 0 and "Filtered")
  valid_row_sum <- sum(as.numeric(column_values[valid_rows]), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Print the results for the current column
  cat("Column:", col, "\n")
  cat("  Valid Row Count (excluding '0', 'Filtered'):", valid_row_count, "\n")
  cat("  Sum of Valid Rows (excluding '0', 'Filtered'):", valid_row_sum, "\n\n")
}


```

#Count valid phospho precursors rows based on number

```{r}
  
# Filter rows where EG.PrecursorId contains "Phospho"
filtered_phospho_data <- filtered_nonlocalized_data[grepl("Phospho", filtered_nonlocalized_data$EG.PrecursorId), ]

# Loop over each "TotalQuantity" column in the filtered_phospho_data
for (col in total_quantity_columns_filtered) {
  # Get the column values
  column_values <- filtered_phospho_data[[col]]
  
  # Filter out rows with 0, 1, or "Filtered"
  valid_rows <- !(column_values %in% c(0, 1, "Filtered"))
  
  # Count the number of valid rows (excluding 0, 1, and "Filtered")
  valid_row_count <- sum(valid_rows)
  
  # Calculate the sum of valid rows (excluding 0, 1, and "Filtered")
  valid_row_sum <- sum(as.numeric(column_values[valid_rows]), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Print the results for the current column
  cat("Column:", col, "\n")
  cat("  Valid Row Count (excluding 0, 1, 'Filtered') in Phospho rows:", valid_row_count, "\n")
  cat("  Sum of Valid Rows (excluding 0, 1, 'Filtered') in Phospho rows:", valid_row_sum, "\n\n")
}

```

#Count valid phospho precursors rows based on intensity

```{r}
# Loop over each "TotalQuantity" column in the filtered_nonlocalized_data
for (col in total_quantity_columns_filtered) {
  
  # Get the column values
  column_values <- filtered_nonlocalized_data[[col]]
  
  # Total number of rows in the full dataset
  total_rows <- nrow(filtered_nonlocalized_data)
  
  # Count of rows containing "Phospho" in EG.PrecursorId
  phospho_rows <- sum(grepl("Phospho", filtered_nonlocalized_data$EG.PrecursorId))
  
  # Percent of Phospho rows out of total rows
  percent_phospho_rows <- (phospho_rows / total_rows) * 100
  
  # Total abundance (sum of values in the column)
  total_abundance <- sum(as.numeric(column_values), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Get the phospho values from rows where EG.PrecursorId contains "Phospho"
  phospho_column_values <- column_values[grepl("Phospho", filtered_nonlocalized_data$EG.PrecursorId)]
  
  # Total phospho abundance
  total_phospho_abundance <- sum(as.numeric(phospho_column_values), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Percent of Phospho abundance out of total abundance
  percent_phospho_abundance <- (total_phospho_abundance / total_abundance) * 100
  
  # Print the results for the current column
  cat("Column:", col, "\n")
  cat("  Percent of Phospho rows out of total rows:", round(percent_phospho_rows, 2), "%\n")
  cat("  Percent of Phospho abundance out of total abundance:", round(percent_phospho_abundance, 2), "%\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
# Initialize an empty list to store the results
results <- list()

# Loop over each "TotalQuantity" column in filtered_nonlocalized_data
for (col in total_quantity_columns_filtered) {
  # Get the column values
  column_values <- filtered_nonlocalized_data[[col]]
  
  # Filter out rows with 0, 1, or "Filtered"
  valid_rows <- !(column_values %in% c(0, 1, "Filtered"))
  
  # Filtered data based on valid rows
  filtered_data <- filtered_nonlocalized_data[valid_rows, ]
  
  # Total number of valid rows (excluding 0, 1, and "Filtered")
  total_rows <- nrow(filtered_data)
  
  # Count of phospho rows in EG.PrecursorId after filtering valid rows
  phospho_rows <- sum(grepl("Phospho", filtered_data$EG.PrecursorId))
  
  # Percent of Phospho rows out of total valid rows
  percent_phospho_rows <- (phospho_rows / total_rows) * 100
  
  # Total abundance (sum of values in the column, excluding invalid rows)
  total_abundance <- sum(as.numeric(column_values[valid_rows]), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Get the phospho values from the filtered data
  phospho_column_values <- column_values[valid_rows & grepl("Phospho", filtered_data$EG.PrecursorId)]
  
  # Total phospho abundance (sum of phospho values)
  phospho_abundance <- sum(as.numeric(phospho_column_values), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Percent of Phospho abundance out of total abundance
  percent_phospho_abundance <- ifelse(total_abundance != 0, (phospho_abundance / total_abundance) * 100, 0)
  
  # Store the results in the list
  results[[col]] <- list(
    Total_Rows = total_rows,
    Phospho_Rows = phospho_rows,
    Percent_Phospho_Rows = round(percent_phospho_rows, 2),
    Total_Abundance = total_abundance,
    Phospho_Abundance = phospho_abundance,
    Percent_Phospho_Abundance = round(percent_phospho_abundance, 2)
  )
}

# Convert the list into a data frame
results_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results, data.frame, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))

# Save the results to a CSV file
write.csv(results_df, "PolyA_TiO_phospho_summary.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Export the filtered_nonlocalized_data to a TSV file
write.table(filtered_nonlocalized_data, "PolyA_TiO_filtered_nonlocalized_data.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

write.table(filtered_data, "PolyA_TiO_filtered_data.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)


```
